questions.prompt: With maxInlineTokens 1000 and 200 tokens kept for the notice, how many characters of each end does the model see?
questions.explanation: (1000 - 200) / 2 is 400 tokens for each end, and at 4 characters per token that is 1600 characters.

questions.prompt: Why does the spill listener call next() before it measures the content?
options: So it measures the content after every other listener has accepted or replaced it
Because next() writes the spill file
So the model sees the full text first
Because measuring is faster after next()
questions.explanation: The listener runs first because it is prepended, then waits for the rest of the chain. It cuts the final content, not a version another listener would still change.

questions.prompt: The failing test the model needs is in the middle of a spilled result. What can the model do?
options: Nothing, because the middle is deleted
Ask the harness to resend the whole result
Search the spill file named in the notice with its file tools
Run the command again with a larger context window
questions.explanation: The full text is saved in the file, and the notice gives its path and tells the model to read parts of it or grep it.
